description: NLP extraction evaluation cases for the AI-Based Symptom Checker. Each case contains a realistic user input and the expected canonical symptoms, severity, duration and onset that the extraction pipeline should produce. Severity uses MILD / MODERATE / SEVERE or is omitted when not mentioned. Duration and onset are optional free-text fields that the extractor should normalize.

cases.input: I've had a really bad headache and feel like throwing up since yesterday
cases.notes: Tests 'bad headache' → severity SEVERE, 'throwing up' → nausea, 'since yesterday' → 1 day

cases.input: my throat hurts and I have a runny nose, been sneezing all day
cases.notes: Tests multiple ENT symptoms from a common cold description

cases.input: I have fever with chills and my whole body is aching for the past 3 days
cases.notes: Tests typical flu/dengue presentation with duration

cases.input: mujhe bahut tez bukhar hai aur pet me dard ho raha hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish input: 'tez bukhar' → fever SEVERE, 'pet me dard' → abdominal_pain

cases.input: chest pain that goes to my left arm and I'm sweating a lot
cases.notes: Tests cardiac emergency pattern — red flag combination

cases.input: I have been coughing for about 2 weeks and noticed some blood in the mucus today
cases.notes: Tests TB-suspicious presentation; 'blood in the mucus' → coughing_blood

cases.input: My skin has been really itchy with a circular red patch on my arm, it looks like a ring
cases.notes: Tests dermatological description of ringworm; 'ring' → ring_shaped_rash

cases.input: feeling dizzy and tired all the time, also my skin looks pale lately
cases.notes: Tests anaemia presentation with lay terms 'dizzy', 'tired', 'pale'

cases.input: burns when I pee and I need to go to the bathroom every hour, lower belly also hurts
cases.notes: Tests UTI presentation; 'burns when I pee' → burning_urination

cases.input: I have acidity and a sour taste keeps coming up in my mouth especially after eating
cases.notes: Tests GERD; 'acidity' → heartburn, 'sour taste coming up' → acid_regurgitation

cases.input: severe stomach pain on the right side near my hip, I also feel nauseous
cases.notes: Tests appendicitis presentation; 'right side near my hip' → lower_right_abdominal_pain

cases.input: my eyes are red and sticky, there's yellowish gunk in the morning
cases.notes: Tests conjunctivitis; 'sticky' + 'yellowish gunk' → eye_discharge

cases.input: I can't breathe properly and there's a whistling sound when I exhale
cases.notes: Tests asthma; 'can't breathe properly' → shortness_of_breath, 'whistling sound' → wheezing

cases.input: I got lots of small itchy bumps between my fingers, they're worse at night
cases.notes: Tests scabies description; 'small itchy bumps' as primary symptom. Night worsening is a temporal detail, not a separate symptom.

cases.input: woke up with the worst headache of my life, it came on suddenly
cases.notes: Tests thunderclap headache red flag; 'worst headache of my life' + 'suddenly' → sudden_severe_headache

cases.input: loose motions for 2 days, can't keep water down, feeling very weak
cases.notes: Tests gastroenteritis with dehydration risk; 'loose motions' → diarrhea, 'can't keep water down' → unable_to_keep_fluids_down

cases.input: high fever since 4 days with pain behind my eyes and joints are hurting badly
cases.notes: Tests dengue presentation; 'high fever' → SEVERE, 'hurting badly' → SEVERE

cases.input: my nose is completely blocked, face feels like pressure around cheeks and forehead, thick green mucus
cases.notes: Tests sinusitis; 'blocked' → nasal_congestion, 'pressure around cheeks and forehead' → facial_pain_or_pressure

cases.input: I'm peeing a lot more than usual and always feel thirsty, also lost some weight recently
cases.notes: Tests diabetes presentation; classic triad of polyuria, polydipsia, weight loss

cases.input: kamar me bahut dard hai, 1 hafte se chal raha hai, jhukne me dikkat hoti hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish input: 'kamar me bahut dard' → lower_back_pain SEVERE, 'jhukne me dikkat' → muscle_stiffness

cases.input: I feel extremely anxious all the time, my heart races and I can't sleep properly
cases.notes: Tests anxiety presentation; 'heart races' → palpitations, sleep disruption → fatigue

cases.input: pet mein bahut gas ban rahi hai aur bloating ho rahi hai, khana khane ke baad aur bura lagta hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish: 'gas ban rahi hai' → bloating, 'pet mein dard' → abdominal_pain

cases.input: there are raised welts all over my skin, very itchy, appeared after eating prawns
cases.notes: Tests allergic reaction; 'raised welts' → hives, 'very itchy' → itchy_skin

cases.input: mujhe raat ko bahut pasina aata hai aur bhook bilkul nahi lagti, 3 hafte se yahi ho raha hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish TB-suspicion: 'raat ko pasina' → night_sweats, 'bhook nahi' → loss_of_appetite

cases.input: I have joint pain and swelling in both knees that is mild but constant for a month
cases.notes: Tests chikungunya / arthritis pattern; explicit MILD severity; joint_swelling as separate symptom

cases.input: skin pe bahut saari pimples aa gayi hain, chehra bahut oily rehta hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish acne presentation: 'pimples' → pimples, 'oily' → oily_skin

cases.input: I notice my skin and eyes have turned yellowish, urine is very dark brown
cases.notes: Tests hepatitis/jaundice triad; 'yellowish' → yellow_skin_or_eyes, 'dark brown urine' → dark_urine

cases.input: I feel very sad and hopeless every day, no energy to do anything, not interested in food
cases.notes: Tests depression-associated somatic symptoms; mood words map to physical symptom IDs only

cases.input: sudden weakness on right side of my face, arm is also numb, speech is slurred
cases.notes: Tests stroke red flags; FAST symptom combination

cases.input: I have a moderate headache with light bothering me and I feel sick
cases.notes: Tests migraine aura presentation; explicit MODERATE severity; 'light bothering' → light_sensitivity

cases.input: mujhe bahut kamzori ho rahi hai, aankhein peeli lag rahi hain aur pet ke upar dahi taraf dard hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish hepatitis: 'kamzori' → fatigue, 'aankhein peeli' → yellow_skin_or_eyes, 'upar dahi taraf dard' → upper_right_abdominal_pain

cases.input: my stomake is aching and i hav diarrhoea since morning, also some vomting
cases.notes: Tests misspelled input: 'stomake aching' → abdominal_pain, 'vomting' → vomiting, 'diarrhoea' is British spelling

cases.input: skin is dry and flaky, especially around the elbows and scalp
cases.notes: Tests psoriasis/eczema; 'dry' → dry_skin, 'flaky' → scaly_skin

cases.input: I have fever of 104, bleeding from the gums and a red rash on my body
cases.notes: Tests dengue haemorrhagic presentation; 'bleeding gums' → bleeding_gums_or_nose, 'rash on my body' → skin_rash

cases.input: mujhe khansi aur saans lene me takleef ho rahi hai, thoda blood bhi aa raha hai khansi me, 3 hafton se
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish TB red flags: 'khansi' → cough, 'saans lene me takleef' → shortness_of_breath, 'blood in khansi' → coughing_blood

cases.input: I've had a mild fever and a rash that looks like spots on my trunk, been itchy for 5 days
cases.notes: Tests chickenpox / typhoid rash variant; explicit MILD fever + skin_rash + itchy_skin

cases.input: my heart is beating very fast and I feel like I'm going to pass out
cases.notes: Tests cardiac arrhythmia pattern; 'beating very fast' → palpitations, 'pass out' → fainting

cases.input: there is pain in my side below the ribs and my urine has blood in it
cases.notes: Tests kidney stone / pyelonephritis; 'side below the ribs' → flank_pain, 'blood in urine' → blood_in_urine

cases.input: mujhe bahut thakaan ho rahi hai, wajan bhi kam ho raha hai bina kisi reason ke, 1 mahine se
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish constitutional symptoms: 'thakaan' → fatigue, 'wajan kam' → weight_loss

cases.input: I had a seizure this morning, I also had a stiff neck and fever yesterday
cases.notes: Tests meningitis + seizure emergency combo; stiff_neck + fever + seizure is a red-flag triad

cases.input: headack and feeling nausius for 2 days, also cant smell anything
cases.notes: Tests misspellings: 'headack' → headache, 'nausius' → nausea, 'cant smell' → loss_of_smell_or_taste (post-viral)

cases.input: mujhe aankh me dard hai aur sab kuch dhundla dikh raha hai, aankh laal bhi ho gayi hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish eye complaint: 'dhundla' → blurred_vision, 'aankh laal' → red_eye

cases.input: I feel a tight sensation in my chest and shortness of breath, lips look slightly blue
cases.notes: Tests severe respiratory emergency; 'bluish lips' → bluish_lips_or_face is a red flag

cases.input: I can't swallow properly, my throat feels swollen and I can hardly breathe through my mouth
cases.notes: Tests anaphylaxis / severe angioedema; 'throat swollen' → throat_or_tongue_swelling

cases.input: gale me bahut dard hai, kuch bhi nahi nigal pa raha hoon, halka bukhar bhi hai
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish tonsillitis: 'gale me dard' → sore_throat, 'nahi nigal pa raha' → painful_swallowing, 'halka bukhar' → fever MILD

cases.input: I have fluid filled blisters on one side of my chest, it burns a lot and is very painful
cases.notes: Tests shingles presentation; 'fluid filled blisters' → fluid_filled_blisters, 'burns and painful skin' → warm_tender_skin

cases.input: mujhe bar bar chhink aati hai, naak bahut beh rahi hai, aankhein bhi khujli kar rahi hain
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish allergic rhinitis: 'chhink' → sneezing, 'naak beh rahi' → runny_nose, 'aankhein khujli' → itchy_eyes

cases.input: my poo looks black and tarry, and I vomited something that looked like coffee grounds
cases.notes: Tests GI bleed emergency; 'black and tarry' → black_or_bloody_stool, 'coffee grounds vomit' → vomiting_blood

cases.input: I have moderate lower back pain for 3 days that gets worse when I sit, no other symptoms
cases.notes: Tests isolated MODERATE severity extraction; postural back pain with explicit severity word

cases.input: body me dard hai, bukhaar hai, thakaan hai, naak bhi beh rahi hai, khansi bhi hai, 2 din se
cases.notes: Tests Hinglish multi-symptom flu: 5 symptoms in one sentence — body_aches, fever, fatigue, runny_nose, cough
